'''Steve Kuperman'''<ref name="dt-15393">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15393 Hunt Down By Crazy Hermit The Revenge Of Scooby-Doo], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 18 April 2001).
